title: Morning Brief — Wednesday, 21 October 2026
description: A new Human Rights Commission report finds pregnancy discrimination still widespread in Australian workplaces, Queensland's Adult Crime, Adult Time laws expand amid continued debate, and the Gold Coast 500 Supercars finals opener brings crowds to Surfers Paradise this weekend. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
